{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Democrats are committed to closing the Halliburton loophole that stripped the Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) of its ability to regulate hydraulic fracturing.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats are committed to ensuring tough safeguards are in place, including Safe Drinking Water Act provisions, to protect local water supplies.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats believe hydraulic fracturing should not take place where states and local communities oppose it.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will reduce methane emissions from all oil and gas production and transportation by at least 40 to 45 percent below 2005 levels by 2025 through common-sense standards for both new and existing sources.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will reduce methane emissions from all oil and gas production and transportation by repairing and replacing thousands of miles of leaky pipes.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Reducing methane emissions from all oil and gas production and transportation will both protect the climate and create thousands of good-paying jobs.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will work to expand access to cost-saving renewable energy by low-income households.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will create good-paying jobs in communities that have struggled with energy poverty.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will oppose efforts by utilities to limit consumer choice or slow clean energy deployment.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will streamline federal permitting to accelerate the construction of new transmission lines to get low-cost renewable energy to market.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will incentivize wind, solar, and other renewable energy over the development of new natural gas power plants.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
